notes.title: Introducing: Dust Dwellers
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, and welcome! [/h1]

[b]Dust Dwellers[/b] is a survival card game, for both singleplayer and online co-op, currently in development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43645217/82a3086c6c64906001f175e77848fa21beffc8ed.png[/img]

If you'd like to keep up with our progress and be notified when the game is released, be sure to [b]follow[/b] and [b]wishlist[/b]!

Soon we will begin conducting some preliminary playtests and collecting your feedback to help guide the future of the project. If you'd like to be a part of that, or just to follow the development more closely, you can join us on [b][url=https://discord.gg/7EKYG43ptj]Discord[/url][/b]!

[url=https://discord.gg/7EKYG43ptj][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43645217/94d3b517b7433a6cb8ba79d08602518a9a5baf36.png[/img][/url]

Quite literally, this game began as a dream. A fleeting yet visceral dream I had one night more than five years ago which has stuck with me since. Riding on the back of a jeep, my hands on a mounted Gatling gun, I looked out over a sparse wasteland, which soon was clear had formerly been the ocean floor. And the reason for this massive firepower was chasing after us: a pack of immense mechanical beasts. In short, this was like the world of Mad Max meeting Horizon Zero Dawn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43645217/3970dba3665e584e23e71baf6d839dee7e8bf99d.png[/img]

Fast forward to 2022 when I decided to prototype a tabletop game based in this world. I even got my arts 'n crafts on and made some tokens to go with the (index) cards. Having iterated on the mechanics, I gathered some friends to play together in person. And we had a good time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43645217/909f3b161c0922394e08b3865bea1f7118631cd0.png[/img]

With the initial playtesting proven promising, I felt it would be a good opportunity to adapt this into a digital card game. Now, the core loop is operational, including online co-op! Currently, I'm focused on implementing enhancements to the user experience.

Meanwhile, the art for the project is gradually coming together. Late last year, I connected with the talented [b][url=https://www.ekpap.com/]Pierce Papke[/url][/b], who has been creating illustrations for the cards, which we've been sharing over our socials. Be sure to [b][url=https://twitter.com/CrimsonStoneDev]follow there[/url][/b] if you'd like to see more of the art as it's created and other project updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43645217/db3a78a251a9670102c6419252fbce948a0be3aa.png[/img]

And that's where the project now stands. As mentioned, if you'd like to be part of our upcoming playtests, you can join us in our [b][url=https://discord.gg/7EKYG43ptj]Discord[/url][/b]. And as always, every wishlist is much appreciated!
